shots.subject: The holographic threshold and Demian stepping through
shots.continuity_notes: Demian is shivering, wet from the pool, and holding the seismic hammer. He transitions out of the basement.
shots.performance: Demian lets out a bitter, exhausted smirk and mutters hoarsely, "Oh, this is going to be so much fun." (fact_classification: proposal). Y.D.'s voice drops the game show persona as a distorted, nightmarish carnival melody begins to play from hidden speakers.
shots.blocking: Close detail on the edge of the Amusement Park holographic threshold, where a faint draft physically disturbs the projection. Demian's shivering hands tightly grip the heavy seismic hammer as he steps into the frame. He deliberately walks through the curtain of light, the hologram washing over him to reveal the dark, physical corridor stretching out ahead.
